description: Implementation of the AdministrationService for OpenMRS, providing methods for managing global properties, system info, locales, implementation IDs, and system configurations within the OpenMRS healthcare platform.

classes.name: AdministrationServiceImpl
classes.description: Default implementation of the AdministrationService interface, providing management of global system properties, locale preferences, system info, and system configuration for OpenMRS.

methods.name: getSystemVariables
methods.description: Retrieves a map of system variables such as hostname, version, OS info, and database info, caching the result for efficiency.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specified global property if the user has permission to view it.

methods.name: setGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with the specified name and value.

methods.name: updateGlobalProperty
methods.description: Updates the value of an existing global property, with privilege checks.

methods.name: getAllGlobalProperties
methods.description: Returns a list of all global properties the current user has privilege to view.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesByPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties with names matching a specific prefix.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertiesBySuffix
methods.description: Retrieves global properties with names matching a specific suffix.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperty
methods.description: Deletes a specified global property after privilege validation.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperties
methods.description: Batch saves a list of global properties, adding new ones or updating existing ones.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Saves a single global property, updating privileges and validating locales.

methods.name: getImplementationId
methods.description: Returns the current implementation ID, deserialized from global properties.

methods.name: setImplementationId
methods.description: Sets and persists a new implementation ID after server validation and source creation.

methods.name: getAllowedLocales
methods.description: Returns a list of locales permitted by the global property and system defaults.

methods.name: getPresentationLocales
methods.description: Determines and returns locales suitable for displaying to users based on allowed locales and message source.

methods.name: globalPropertyChanged
methods.description: Listener method that resets cached presentation locales upon change in allowed locales.

methods.name: globalPropertyDeleted
methods.description: Placeholder for handling global property deletion events (currently unimplemented).

methods.name: supportsPropertyName
methods.description: Checks if the listener supports a given property name, specifically locale allowed list.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyByUuid
methods.description: Fetches a global property by its UUID if the user is authorized.

methods.name: getGlobalPropertyValue
methods.description: Retrieves and converts a global property value into a specified type, based on a default value.

methods.name: getSystemInformation
methods.description: Collects and returns detailed system info including JVM, OS, database, and modules.

methods.name: purgeGlobalProperties
methods.description: Removes multiple global properties from the system.

methods.name: getMaximumPropertyLength
methods.description: Gets maximum allowed length of a property for a given class and field.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Uses DAO to validate an object against system constraints, collecting validation errors.

methods.name: getSearchLocales
methods.description: Provides a cached list of locales suitable for searching, based on current locale and user proficiency.

methods.name: setImplementationIdHttpClient
methods.description: Sets the HTTP client used for remote implementation ID validation.

methods.name: isDatabaseStringComparisonCaseSensitive
methods.description: Checks if the database performs case-sensitive string comparisons.

methods.name: updatePostgresSequence
methods.description: Updates the sequence in Postgres databases to maintain consistency.

methods.name: getSerializerWhitelistTypes
methods.description: Returns a list of allowed serializer class type strings, including defaults and global property-specified types.

methods.name: getSerializerDefaultWhitelistHierarchyTypes
methods.description: Provides a list of default class types permitted for serialization, including core OpenMRS classes and custom data types.
